scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply passing-place --local && wrangler dev
scripts.build:pages: npm run build && mkdir -p pages/dist && cp -R public/. pages/dist/ && cp pages/_headers pages/_routes.json pages/dist/
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages dev ./dist --service APP=passing-place --cwd ./pages
scripts.pages:project:create: wrangler pages project create passing-place-pages --production-branch master --cwd ./pages
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages deploy ./dist --project-name passing-place-pages --cwd ./pages
